title: Houthi Strikes Wound 13 in Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif; Coalition Vows Firm Response
detail: Houthi missiles and drones struck the Saudi cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif late on September 14 into September 15, 2026, wounding 13 civilians across the three cities. Saudi-led coalition spokesman Major-General Turki al-Maliki said the 'Joint Forces Command of the Coalition will deal with these attacks responsibly and firmly to protect the sovereignty of the kingdom.' The Houthis claimed Saudi Arabia had conducted 54 air raids across five Yemeni governorates — Lahj, Taiz, al-Jawf, Marib and Hajjah — in the preceding 24 hours, with Saudi airstrikes reportedly targeting government complexes in Taiz province; Houthi-aligned media said 3 civilians, including 2 children, were killed and at least 2 others wounded in one such strike.

media.caption: Saudi-led coalition vows a firm response after Houthi strikes wound civilians in three cities

confidenceReason: Saudi civilian-casualty count (13) is Tier 1/2 sourced; the Houthi count of 54 coalition airstrikes and the Taiz civilian toll are single-sided claims from Houthi-aligned media.
